verdict.rationale: Freshsales publishes documented REST API docs with per-user API keys. The endpoints cover leads, contacts, deals, tasks, search, files, lists, custom modules and async job status, with full read, modify, add and delete over account data. Probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec, llms.txt or markdown docs, which limits machine-readable discovery for AI agents. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: such as reading, modifying, adding or deleting data from your helpdesk.
Each user in Freshsales is provided with a unique API key.
